title: Evolutio's row carries neither resolved verticals nor a researched stack, so its rank encodes only size
content:
Evolutio is in the priority-4 pool without either of the facts that pool is meant to sort on. Its v2 verticals are recorded as "not resolved" and its tool field as "not researched". The row is a provisional carry-over from the tail of the v2 ranking, rescored mechanically on size and slot occupancy alone.

With the stack unknown, only one of those two scoring inputs could actually have been computed. Slot occupancy cannot be assessed against a blank platform field, which leaves size as the effective determinant of the rank. That makes priority 4 a statement about how big the company is and nothing else.

This is a research task rather than a lead. The honest next step is the OSS-portfolio screen the flag asks for plus a vertical resolution pass; until one of those produces something, there is no claim about Evolutio to act on.
